title: Insertion diagrams and ideal-preserving tower comparisons
statement: For finite ordinary blowup towers [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule] [def-nagata-global-blowup] on Noetherian schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth] with coherent center ideals [pqf-def-coherent], define the following insertion data (Temkin Definition 4.2.2). An input consists of a tower A over X, a position 0≤m≤n, an open U⊆X, and an inserted tower G over A_m whose center images avoid U. Each old center C_i for i≥m equals the schematic closure [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-closure] of its restriction over U. A diagram is a replacement suffix B over the terminal scheme of G, of length n−m, with Noetherian levels and coherent centers, and isomorphisms (A_i)_U≅(B_{i−m})_U over X commuting with transitions. Its center ideal is the kernel of the map from the restricted old center through this isomorphism into B_{i−m}. Concatenation with the fixed prefix and G is represented by these three segments. A suffix isomorphism consists of level isomorphisms over the terminal scheme of G, commuting with transitions and preserving all ordered center ideals. An uncontracted tower pullback over f:Y→X consists of equal lengths, cartesian level maps, transition compatibility and equality of each new ideal with the extension of its old ideal; input pullback additionally preserves m and U and compares G over the induced level-m map [def-weil-flat-morphism]. The first-center transform at a level of G is the kernel of the strict-transform map [def-nagata-strict-transform] relative to the inverse image of U. An induced center tower has these transforms as closed level images, starts with C_m, and blows up each pulled-back ambient center. Generic image points are generic points of maximal irreducible subsets of the image. Pure image codimension e means dim O_{X,x}=e at every such point; density above those points means a section on any open of the center vanishing in every stalk above those points is zero. Reducedness of a center means reducedness of its associated subscheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme].
